items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Because I wasn't exposed to Louis Armstrong then, you know. Or Bix.

ctx.x: In Detroit, and you said Doll Jones... Oh, you said you used to have a thing where you'd walk into the place, and you'd go up to the bar...

Yeah. Well, see, I'd stand outside at first and see who I heard playing, you know. And this night I heard a trumpet player... It wasn't the night that Bix was playing.
